changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW reports.vwpatientattachments AS SELECT pa.id, pa.patient_id, pa.created_by, pa.space_key, pa.filename, pa.mime_type, pa.size_bytes, pa.created_date, pa.deleted_at, pa.type, pa.details, pa.source, pa.last_modified_by, pa.last_modified_date FROM public.patient_attachments pa;

changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA reports TO report_user;
GRANT SELECT ON reports.vwpatientattachments TO report_user;

rollback.sql: REVOKE SELECT ON reports.vwpatientattachments FROM report_user;
